responsibilities.what: Keyboard shortcut routing itself (which key triggers which command, link mode precedence, Space/Ctrl+K opens add menu)
Fit viewport to graph bounds on first layout

rationale: Every document mutation the canvas triggered still has a tested SceneEditSession/SceneWorkspaceController owner, but nothing in apps/avelune_studio/lib calls them for scenes any more. The canvas's own logic has no HEAD owner: the wire and keyboard-link state machines, the start-target exclusion, the edge hit-test selection, screen-to-world conversion, the stale-menu async guard (_menuRevision), shortcut routing and first-layout fit. The no-op move guard now relies only on an untested commit equality, and a node without a layout falls back to a grid position that no longer exists. Heuristic owner SceneGraphViewport is gone at HEAD. SceneGraphViewport (apps/avelune_studio/lib/features/scenes/coordination/scene_graph_viewport.dart) was deleted in the same commit 505f1b71a; the coordination/ directory is empty at HEAD. The map_editor SceneGraphViewport (packages/map_editor/lib/src/ui/canvas/scenes/scene_graph_read_only_view.dart) is an unrelated immutable value type in the legacy editor package and is not a Studio owner.

responsibilities.what: Edge routing curve (cubic with bend = max(48, |dx|/2)) used for hit-testing
Edge hit-test for selection (10px tolerance sampled every 6px, topmost edge first, dangling edges skipped)

rationale: SceneCanvasPainter.paint (grid, colours, arrows) is pure painting. But sceneEdgeAt is the only edge-selection hit-test, and scene_graph_canvas used it to pick between selecting an edge and clearing the selection. It has no HEAD owner and no test. Heuristic owner SceneGraphViewport is absent at HEAD and never held this logic.

rationale: The heuristic's ui_retire claim is wrong. The surface changes viewport state (pan, zoom, trackpad focal anchoring, fit, centre-on) and gates gestures while a wire is in progress. The viewport owner (scene_graph_viewport.dart, with its .3-2.5 zoom clamp and .3-1.1 fit clamp) was deleted in 505f1b71a and no HEAD test covers this behaviour. The remaining parts (theme colours, minimap visibility threshold, hint text, tooltips) are visual.

rationale: The heuristic's ui_retire claim is wrong for the interaction: tapping or dragging the minimap moves the viewport through a world projection. Neither that nor the viewport owner exists at HEAD. The visible-rect computation only feeds painting and would be visual on its own, but it shares the lost projection.

rationale: sceneNodeColor, sceneBlockColor, sceneBlockIcon and the card and port styling are visual. The gesture semantics are not: the trackpad-vs-drag discrimination and keyboard activation selection have no HEAD owner. The drag lifecycle reaches a tested final command, but the gesture itself is untested. The heuristic owner SceneWorkspaceController only manages sessions (open/create/discard/save) and holds none of this.

responsibilities.what: Add-block picker: case-insensitive label filter and returning the chosen block

rationale: Low severity. The dialog never mutates the scene: the add action lives in scene_graph_canvas._menu, and SceneEditSession.addAt is tested. Its only logic is a block-search filter with no HEAD equivalent. sceneNodeMatches (scene_node_search.dart) searches existing nodes, not insertable blocks. If that filter is accepted as presentation state, this file becomes retired_ui. The heuristic's ui_retire is defensible only under that reading.
